title: Give OLY-B-GOAL-03 a mechanism: forecasts committed before dispatch
summary: Record the existing pre-dispatch forecast path (reader forecasts committed in reading.rs and scored per class in status.rs) as the mechanism for OLY-B-GOAL-03 in docs/spec.toml, with measure ending `status: forecasts`. Add a "forecasts" entry to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS and a test that fails without the pre-dispatch forecast. Audience: Athena's maintainers and the Hestia spec pass.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus cargo test and clippy pass criterion.
Test asserts forecasts are committed/printed, not just that wiring exists.
Measure ends in a status label that status actually prints.
Reuse the existing forecast path; one focused change.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read docs/spec.toml (OLY-B-GOAL-01..04 entries, line ~2089), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (commits reading with forecasts before any work; refuses oversize wall-time forecast in build_reading), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS at line 305, class_forecasts, StatusView.forecasts, test every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line at ~1630), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (forecasts line at ~1390), crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (spec pass at ~1230). No new record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord round-trip is unaffected. The property is measured directly: the reading's forecasts exist in the committed reading before dispatch, and status prints per-class scored forecasts.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, docs/spec.toml; the change extends them and creates no new mechanism of its own where one already exists.

The `forecasts` label is not yet in STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS; the existing label test requires the source to contain a literal `"forecasts ` string, so the display line needs a literal beginning with that text (the current code builds the label through a variable).
The change adds no refusal rule; it refuses no new readings (expected 0% of newly refused readings).
Governance files such as athena.toml and defaults.toml are not changed; no workflow or Environment reach is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-GOAL-03 has a mechanism naming existing paths (crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs) instead of "none", keeps owner Athena, and a measure ending `status: forecasts`; check by Grep of docs/spec.toml.

STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs contains ("forecasts", "forecasts") and the `athena status` display prints a line starting with that label (crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs); check by Grep and diff.

A new test fails without the mechanism and passes with it: it builds a reading without or with forecasts before dispatch (or a status view with scored forecasts) and asserts the forecast is present/committed and that the `forecasts` line is printed; run `cargo test` and confirm the test passes, and that removing the forecast makes it fail.
`cargo test` (including every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line and the xtask spec test), `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.

out_of_scope: Changing other requirements' mechanisms or measures in docs/spec.toml
Changing forecast scoring or the reference forecast logic
Edits to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
